title: Allergen test and immune-boosting drink from the S-4 nurse
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Allergen test and immune-boosting drink from the S-4 nurse, about 1988-1989 at S-4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um they gave me something to drink, which is supposedly supposed to boost my immune system.

related.note: This is the same drink Lazar says he was given at S-4. The stored story has him telling Vallee it caused memory lapses, while here it is an immune booster given after an allergen test.
